text: ## PR description ### [Perf] Minimax-H3 support fused RMSNorm and RoPE opt [labels: ready, diffusion, Kernel optimization] PLEASE FILL IN THE PR DESCRIPTION HERE. ## Purpose Enable MiniMax-H3 to use the fused RMSNorm and RoPE implementations provided by the Omni diffusion layers. - Add configurable weight dtype support to Omni diffusion `RMSNorm`, while preserving fp32 accumulation in the native fallback. - Extend Omni diffusion `RotaryEmbedding` to support full-head-dimension `cos`/`sin` inputs required by MiniMax-H3. ## Test Plan ``` MODEL="/data/weights/h3/MiniMax-H3/FL2VA" vllm serve "${MODEL}" \ --omni \ --host 0.0.0.0 \ --port "${PORT}" \ --trust-remote-code \ --num-gpus 8 \ --usp 8 \ --ring 1 \ --text-encoder-tp-size 8 \ --enable-layerwise-offload \ --vae-parallel-mode tile \ --vae-use-tiling \ --vae-patch-parallel-size 8 \ --diffusion-attention-backend FLASH_ATTN ``` prompt："A little girl grows up." image: **vLLM Version:** 0.26.0 **vLLM-Omni Commit:** 5215e03a91adecbb5ffece29aa74360a7569d0c5 ## Test Result **Performance:** E2E Latency: 491014ms -> 475070ms. **-3.35%** ori: opt: **Precision:** ori (left) vs opt (right) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3cbd06eb-8e77-4106-a42a-eba346f71873 **BEFORE SUBMITTING:** read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and run the [precheck-pr skill](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/main/.claude/skills/precheck-pr/SKILL.md) with the code agent for a self-check against project conventions.
